layers.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (e-FRRO portal)
layers.process: The area between the Inner Line and the international border is a Protected Area under the Third Schedule of India's Immigration and Foreigners Order 2025; the appendix gives the line's coordinates. Foreigners need a Protected Area Permit beyond it. Apply online at indianfrro.gov.in (the e-FRRO portal) or in the Indian Visa Su-Swagatam app; the permit is issued electronically. Citizens of Afghanistan, China or Pakistan, and people of origin there (born there, a parent or grandparent born and permanently living there, or ever a citizen), need the central government's prior approval. Smartraveller advises applying at least 4 weeks ahead; entering without a permit carries significant penalties.

sites.name: Amarnath cave
sites.what: Holy cave shrine reached on the annual Shri Amarnathji Yatra. Smartraveller: Do not travel to the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir (read 4 November 2026).

access.permits: Yatra permit (Rs 150 at designated bank branches; Rs 250 group) with a Compulsory Health Certificate issued on or after 8 April 2026, Aadhaar biometric eKYC and an RFID card worn at all times; no entry at Domail or Chandanwari without it
access.closures: Ages 13 to 70 only; women more than six weeks pregnant not registered; day and route fixed at registration

lore.text: Local legend says Shiva told the secret of immortality to Parvati in this cave.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source
